name: SERVER_ENTRY
severe_incidents: Unauthorized door forcing, kicking doors, tampering with server room lock, fire, smoke, person collapsed on floor
low_incidents: Employees walking past corridor, cleaning staff with mops, carrying water bottles or laptops
normal_context: Corporate office corridor and server room entrance. Staff walking through and authorized IT personnel entering with keycard are normal. Corridor quiet and lights dimmed. Routine security patrols are normal. Flag forced door tampering or equipment damage.

name: 1ST_ENTRANCE
severe_incidents: Climbing over turnstiles, forced intrusion, physical fighting, scuffling, collapsed person.
low_incidents: Scanning badge and walking through turnstiles, carrying backpacks, delivery parcels
normal_context: Main 1F entrance corridor with turnstiles. Staff walking in, scanning badges, and carrying laptops or bags are normal. Entrance quiet after hours. Routine security guard patrols are normal. Flag jumping turnstiles, forced entry, or intrusion.

name: PARKING
normal_context: Basement parking zone. Employees parking cars, walking to the elevator, and getting in or out of vehicles are normal. Quiet parking lot with parked vehicles and dim lighting. Flag vehicle tampering, break-ins, theft, or loitering.

name: 1ST_OUT
normal_context: Elevator lobby and 1F corridor area. People walking through, waiting for the elevator, or chatting calmly are normal. Quiet lift area. Flag violent scuffles, vandalism, or someone collapsed on the floor.

name: ADMIN_CABIN
severe_incidents: Person using a phone or holding a phone
Person drinking from a cup or mug
Person sleeping or resting their head on a desk
normal_context: Executive admin office. Employees seated at desks, using laptops/monitors, walking through the office, and carrying items are normal. Admin office unoccupied, computers in sleep mode, lights dimmed.

name: 1ST_EXIT
normal_context: Corridor exit doors. Employees walking out to go home or take breaks are normal. Exit doors locked after hours. Flag kicking doors, forced exits, or suspicious loitering.

name: RECEPTION
normal_context: Front desk reception. Staff seated at reception desk, visitors signing in, and people walking past are normal. Reception area quiet with lights dimmed. Flag unauthorized trespass, jumping over the reception counter, or theft.
